fields.Name: Dropbox OAuth
fields.Description: Dropbox app key/secret + offline refresh token for the MJ Dropbox storage driver (File Storage Accounts, Knowledge Hub cloud sources, universal storage search).
fields.FieldSchema: {"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "type": "object", "title": "Dropbox OAuth (refresh token)", "description": "Dropbox app credentials for the MemberJunction Dropbox storage driver: app key/secret from the Dropbox App Console plus an offline (long-lived) refresh token obtained with token_access_type=offline.", "properties": {"appKey": {"type": "string", "title": "App key", "description": "Dropbox app key (client id)", "isSecret": false, "order": 0}, "appSecret": {"type": "string", "title": "App secret", "description": "Dropbox app secret (client secret)", "isSecret": true, "order": 1}, "refreshToken": {"type": "string", "title": "Refresh token", "description": "Offline refresh token for the Dropbox account or team member", "isSecret": true, "order": 2}, "selectUser": {"type": "string", "title": "Team member id (optional)", "description": "Dropbox-API-Select-User member id for Business team apps", "isSecret": false, "order": 3}}, "required": ["appKey", "appSecret", "refreshToken"]}
